After returning Mission: Possible But Not Probable to Shenthul, bring L'aide d'Hinott to Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill. Stay beside him until the brewing objective completes, then hand in the follow-up to learn Poisons. Finish it even if the Zanzil poison has already been removed; removing the debuff alone does not teach the skill.

Poison chain unfinished? Resume your current stage in the Class guide Poisons (Horde); completed quests do not need restarting. Arrange a group for Gallywix, finish the Hinott follow-up, then return to this leveling guide.
